title: LGIC_NAMING round 1 -- the N5 cross-bucket address set (LN-l-2 reads this; its key is N5_KEY.json, which LN-l-2 must not read)
issued_by: 2.0.0_SA_COO~G at L6, from decomposition v3 section 3a.3

briefing_layout.what_you_learned: How an address reads in the main shared bucket, opal-data-assets. Each address is s3://<bucket>/ followed by segments separated by '/'.

segment_roles.source: who the data comes from: a vendor feed, or for derived data the product or system that built it
segment_roles.scope: whose data it is: a firm, a product, a vendor master account, or global
segment_roles.tier: the processing tier: bronze, silver, gold, platinum, state or code
segment_roles.partition: the partition: a date=YYYY-MM-DD, or a named leaf, or an entity=id

briefing_layout.vintage: the three examples were listed live from opal-data-assets by 2.0.0_SA_COO~G on 2026-09-14 (s3api list-objects-v2, read-only)

answer_format: one line per address: <id><TAB><comma-separated roles, one per segment, bucket first>, using only the seven role names above; or <id><TAB>DOES-NOT-FIT when an address does not read the way the layout you learned reads
